doc: Resize an FP32 channel-first image while preserving its layout and format.
NCHW and CHW storage are supported. Nearest sampling follows the donor OA
floor-coordinate rule. Bilinear sampling uses half-pixel centers with
`align_corners = false`.
The call records work asynchronously and returns an Image immediately.
Reading its backing matrix is an explicit submission and observation point.
# Errors
Returns an error for a zero target extent, an empty source extent, a dtype or
layout outside the admitted checkpoint, checked-size overflow, or a runtime
recording failure.
Extract a region, clipping its right and bottom edges to the source extent.
Flip an image horizontally, vertically, or along both axes.
Rotate clockwise by a multiple of 90 degrees.
Add asymmetric padding with an explicit border policy.
Extract a centered region with the requested exact extent.
Resample an image from an FP32 absolute-coordinate map shaped
`[1|batch, 2, output_height, output_width]`.
Apply an inverse FP32 2x3 affine transform to an image.
Apply an inverse FP32 3x3 perspective transform to an image.
Replace values above `threshold` with `max_value` and all others with zero.
Replace values at or below `threshold` with `max_value` and all others with zero.
Truncate values above `threshold`.
Replace values at or below `threshold` with zero.
Replace values above `threshold` with zero.
Produce `true_value` for values inside the inclusive interval and zero outside it.
Clamp every pixel to the inclusive interval.
Invert every value around `max_value`.
Apply `value * contrast + brightness`.
Apply `max(value, 0)^gamma * gain`.
Invert values at or above `threshold` around `max_value`.
Quantize `[low, high]` to `levels` evenly spaced values using round-half-up.
Convert an RGB or RGBA image to Rec.709 grayscale.
Blend two equal semantic images using `a * (1-alpha) + b * alpha`.
Composite two equal images with a clamped Gray or per-channel mask.
Fill the intersection of a rectangle and the image with one finite value.
Apply one shared FP32 `[3, 4]` affine color transform to RGB channels.
Reorder one to four channels and explicitly assign the resulting format.
`order[c]` selects the source channel for output channel `c`. The output
format must have the same channel count as the input so pixel data and
semantic metadata cannot diverge.
Add explicit-seed Philox Gaussian noise to every pixel.
Replace a seeded fraction of pixels with salt or pepper values.
Apply same-shape 2D cross-correlation with an odd FP32 kernel up to 31×31.
Apply horizontal and vertical odd FP32 vector kernels up to length 31.
Average an odd rectangular neighborhood up to 31×31.
Compute one first-order Sobel derivative.
Compute one first-order Scharr derivative.
Apply the four-neighbor discrete Laplacian.
Erode with an odd rectangular structuring element up to 31×31.
Dilate with an odd rectangular structuring element up to 31×31.
Erode and then dilate with the same rectangular element.
Dilate and then erode with the same rectangular element.
Return dilation minus erosion.
Apply a normalized Gaussian blur with replicate borders.
Apply a nonnegative four-neighbor sharpening amount.
Select the median of an odd square neighborhood up to 15×15.
Apply a bilateral neighborhood filter.
Apply an unsharp mask using a Gaussian detail estimate.
Return the source minus its morphological opening.
Return the morphological closing minus the source.

Threshold against a local Gaussian-weighted mean minus `c`.
Apply `(pixel - mean[channel]) / std[channel]` to up to three channels.
Convert between three-channel RGB and BGR semantics, including identity.
Bilinearly resize and normalize in one semantic and executable operation.
Blend a class palette over an RGB/RGBA image using an I32 label map.
